title: Extracting plasmid DNA from Agrobacterium with the Bioline ISOLATE II Plasmid Mini Kit
author: James P B Lloyd
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.s8fehtn
materials: Bioline ISOLATE II Plasmid Mini Kit

steps.title: Grow Agrobacterium culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 5 ml LB medium containing the appropriate antibiotics with Agrobacterium and incubate for 24 h at 29 °C.

steps.title: Pellet culture
steps.instruction: Transfer 3 ml of the saturated 24‑h culture to a microcentrifuge tube and centrifuge for 30 s at 11 000 × g (or two successive spins of 1.5 ml each).

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in P1
steps.instruction: Add 250 µl Resuspension Buffer P1 to the pellet and resuspend by pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Lyse cells with P2
steps.instruction: Add 250 µl Lysis Buffer P2, mix gently by inverting the tube 6–8 times, and incubate at room temperature for up to 5 min or until the lysate becomes clear. Do not vortex.

steps.title: Neutralize lysate with P3
steps.instruction: Add 300 µl Neutralization Buffer P3, mix thoroughly by inverting the tube 6–8 times. Do not vortex.

steps.title: Clarify lysate by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture for 10 min at maximum speed (≈20 817 × g) at room temperature. Keep the pellet undisturbed and carefully transfer the clarified supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Bind DNA to spin column
steps.instruction: Place an ISOLATE II Plasmid Mini Spin Column in a 2 ml collection tube, pipette up to 750 µl (usually less) of the clarified supernatant onto the column, centrifuge 1 min at 11 000 × g, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Wash column with PW1
steps.instruction: Add 500 µl Wash Buffer PW1 pre‑heated to 50 °C (55 °C also works), centrifuge 1 min at 11 000 × g, discard the flow‑through and reuse the collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with PW2
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl Wash Buffer PW2 (supplemented with ethanol), centrifuge 1 min at 11 000 × g, discard the flow‑through and reuse the collection tube.

steps.title: Dry column to remove ethanol
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column for 2 min at 11 000 × g to remove residual ethanol, then place the column in a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Elute plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Add 30–50 µl Elution Buffer P (nuclease‑free water or TE) directly onto the centre of the silica membrane, incubate at room temperature for 1 min, then discard the supernatant and remove as much liquid as possible.

steps.title: Use dilute DNA for downstream work
steps.instruction: Because the eluate is very dilute, use approximately 20 µl of the DNA in a typical restriction‑enzyme digest (less than would be required from an E. coli prep).
